# These Under-$1,000 Finds Prove That Find Design Needn’t Cost a Fortune


For great style and great value, look no further.


by[Colleen Egan](https://www.1stdibs.com/blogs/the-study/contributors/colleen-egan/)


[Pin](https://www.pinterest.com/pin/create/button/)


[Share](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://www.1stdibs.com/blogs/the-study/under-1000-picks/)


[Tweet](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=These%20Under-%241%2C000%20Finds%20Prove%20That%20Find%20Design%20Needn%26%238217%3Bt%20Cost%20a%20Fortune%20on%20The%20Study%3A%20The%20%401stDibs%20Blog&url=https://www.1stdibs.com/blogs/the-study/under-1000-picks/)


Email


We all know the thrill of the hunt, followed by the ecstasy of the find. And if the find happens to be a steal? Well, that’s pure bliss.


At 1stDibs, we take our[Under $1,000 Edit](https://www.1stdibs.com/collections/under-1000-edit/) seriously. From a[Tiffany & Co. cuff](https://www.1stdibs.com/jewelry/bracelets/cuff-bracelets/tiffany-co-elsa-peretti-sterling-silver-thumbprint-cuff-bracelet/id-j_30217132/) to a[Hans Wegner Wishbone chair](https://www.1stdibs.com/furniture/seating/dining-room-chairs/hans-j-wegner-ch24-wishbone-chair-seaweed-natural-papercord-carl-hansen/id-f_47516832/) ,[19th-century English landscapes](https://www.1stdibs.com/furniture/wall-decorations/paintings/19th-century-english-landscape/id-f_51186982/) to[3D-printed lamps](https://www.1stdibs.com/furniture/lighting/table-lamps/contemporary-3d-printed-tesser-53-portable-table-lamp-ridezign-amber/id-f_51086842/) , this collection encompasses a wide range of exceptional design at reasonable prices. Here are some of our favorite picks.


---


[Hermès Evelyne coral-chèvre coin purse, contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/wallets-small-accessories/hermes-evelyne-coral-chevre-coin-purse/id-v_27721672/)


This fruit-punch-hued[Hermès Evelyne chèvre coin purse](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/wallets-small-accessories/hermes-evelyne-coral-chevre-coin-purse/id-v_27721672/) , which bears the logo of the house’s popular[Evelyne bag](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/hermes-evelyne/) line, will greet you with a bright burst of color whenever you reach for a few *sous* .


---


[John Galliano sheer embroidered corset, 2000s](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/clothing/blouses/john-galliano-sheer-laced-boned-bustier-lace-up-embroidered-corset/id-v_30261972/)


John Galliano, who next May will join the small club of designers for whom a Met Gala theme has been named, has experimented with corsetry detailing for years. In this[beautifully structured corset](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/clothing/blouses/john-galliano-sheer-laced-boned-bustier-lace-up-embroidered-corset/id-v_30261972/) , his expertise in the art form is on fully display.


---


[Nao Tamura for Established & Sons Tiki portable table lamp in pebble gray, contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/furniture/lighting/table-lamps/nao-tamura-tiki-portable-table-lamp-pebble-grey-established-sons/id-f_49695922/)


Great design has the power to surprise and delight, which is exactly what this[Nao Tamura for Established & Sons Tiki](https://www.1stdibs.com/furniture/lighting/table-lamps/nao-tamura-tiki-portable-table-lamp-pebble-grey-established-sons/id-f_49695922/) lamp does, to perfection. Even better, it’s portable and powered by a dimmable LED.


---


[Elsa Peretti for Tiffany & Co. sterling-silver Thumbprint cuff bracelet, 20th century](https://www.1stdibs.com/jewelry/bracelets/cuff-bracelets/tiffany-co-elsa-peretti-sterling-silver-thumbprint-cuff-bracelet/id-j_30217132/)


From jewelry to[homeware](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/elsa-peretti-thumbprint/) , Elsa Peretti’s elegant and sculptural Thumbprint collection for Tiffany & Co. is one of her most beloved. This[sterling-silver Thumbprint cuff bracelet](https://www.1stdibs.com/jewelry/bracelets/cuff-bracelets/tiffany-co-elsa-peretti-sterling-silver-thumbprint-cuff-bracelet/id-j_30217132/) is an intriguing expression of the motif, and a petite alternative to Peretti’s famous[Bone cuff](https://www.1stdibs.com/jewelry/bracelets/cuff-bracelets/tiffany-co-elsa-peretti-vintage-large-silver-bone-cuff-bracelet/id-j_29790372/) .


---


[Hans J. Wegner for Carl Hansen CH24 Wishbone chair in seaweed, contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/furniture/seating/dining-room-chairs/hans-j-wegner-ch24-wishbone-chair-seaweed-natural-papercord-carl-hansen/id-f_47516832/)


Hans Wegner’s[Wishbone chair](https://www.1stdibs.com/designs/wishbone-chair/) has been in production since 1950, and over the years it has ascended to icon status. This version, with a seaweed-colored frame and a seat available in natural or black-paper cord, is a refreshing take on the classic design.


---


[Sky Study , 2020, by Michael Budden](https://www.1stdibs.com/art/paintings/landscape-paintings/michael-budden-impressionistic-landscape-cloud-oil-painting-michael-budden-sky-study/id-a_18412512/)


If you’ve ever spent an afternoon lying in the grass and watching the clouds, Michael Budden’s[Sky Study](https://www.1stdibs.com/art/paintings/landscape-paintings/michael-budden-impressionistic-landscape-cloud-oil-painting-michael-budden-sky-study/id-a_18412512/) will evoke the same dreamy feelings. (And if you haven’t spent an afternoon lying in the grass and watching the clouds, you really should.)


---


[Kristian Sofus Hansen & Tommy Hyldahl for Norr11 Naked smoked-glass coffee table, 2025](https://www.1stdibs.com/furniture/tables/coffee-tables-cocktail-tables/contemporary-coffee-table-naked-norr11-smoke-glass/id-f_47068192/)


Whether part of a group or on its own, the[Naked smoked-glass coffee table](https://www.1stdibs.com/furniture/tables/coffee-tables-cocktail-tables/contemporary-coffee-table-naked-norr11-smoke-glass/id-f_47068192/) is a sleek and unexpected alternative to the typical table.


---


[Sac-Bolso by Ethic&Tropic handwoven box from Panama, 2016](https://www.1stdibs.com/furniture/decorative-objects/sculptures/animal-sculptures/decorative-hand-woven-bag-box-from-panama-sac-bolso-ethictropic/id-f_30684552/)


And if you’re in the market for[coffee-table decor](https://www.1stdibs.com/blogs/the-study/coffee-table-style/) , may we suggest this[delightful little creature](https://www.1stdibs.com/furniture/decorative-objects/sculptures/animal-sculptures/decorative-hand-woven-bag-box-from-panama-sac-bolso-ethictropic/id-f_30684552/) , which is actually a box handwoven by indigenous women in Panama.


---


[Chanel CC-logo round sunglasses, contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/accessories/sunglasses/chanel-round-cc-logo-detailed-sunglasses/id-v_26009422/)


With their round, beigey pink frames and mini interlocking-C logo on the temples, these[Chanel sunglasses](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/accessories/sunglasses/chanel-round-cc-logo-detailed-sunglasses/id-v_26009422/) are chic and fresh.


---


[Amalfi Coast , 2021, Ludwig Favre](https://www.1stdibs.com/art/photography/landscape-photography/ludwig-favre-amalfi-coast/id-a_17780662/)


Whether the Amalfi coast holds special memories for you or is on your travel bucket list, this[Ludwig Favre photo](https://www.1stdibs.com/art/photography/landscape-photography/ludwig-favre-amalfi-coast/id-a_17780662/) will transport you there, at least in spirit.
